Services

Interior design

Thoughtful interior design for homes and living spaces that feel calm, personal and easy to live within. This may involve rethinking layouts, selecting materials and finishes, sourcing furniture and lighting, and bringing together colour and texture to create a cohesive environment.

Airbnb and Hospitality

Guest spaces benefit from interiors that feel welcoming, memorable and comfortable. We work with Airbnb hosts as well as cafés and small restaurants to refine layout, atmosphere and styling so the space feels distinctive while remaining relaxed and practical for guests.

Wellbeing Spaces

We design interiors for yoga studios, therapy rooms and retreat environments where calm and simplicity support the purpose of the space. Careful attention is given to light, materials and atmosphere so the environment feels grounded and supportive.

Bespoke Kitchens and Joinery

Alongside the design work, bespoke kitchens, cabinetry and furniture can be created through our workshop in Poynings. Pieces are built and professionally spray finished in house, allowing design and craftsmanship to work closely together throughout the project.

Design Consultation

For clients who need guidance rather than a full project, we offer focused design consultations. These sessions help clarify layout ideas, materials, colour palettes and atmosphere, giving you a clear direction to move forward with confidence.

Every project begins with a conversation about how you want a space to feel and function in everyday life. Some clients are looking for a full redesign, while others simply need guidance to help shape a clear direction.

Our work ranges from complete interior projects to more focused design support depending on the scale and nature of the space.

When it's time to sell

If your property isn’t attracting interest, it’s often not about the building itself but how it’s being seen.

I offer clear, practical guidance to help a space feel welcoming and well proportioned before it goes on the market. This may involve small layout changes, improving lighting, adjusting textiles or suggesting what to store or simplify.

We work mainly with what you already have, making targeted changes where they will have the most impact.

Pricing

Every space is different, but as a rough guide:

- Room design from £1500
- Whole home projects from £4000
- Design consultations from £200

Bespoke kitchens, cabinetry and larger projects are priced once the scope of the project is understood.
